description: This file defines a template-based implementation of the PCG (Permuted Congruential Generator) random number engine, including parameter classes, mixing functions, and specific engine types for 64-bit and 128-bit states, used for generating pseudorandom numbers.

classes.name: pcg_engine
classes.description: Template class implementing a PCG random number generator with customizable parameters and mixing functions.

classes.name: pcg128_params
classes.description: Parameter class for 128-bit PCG engine with specific multiplier and increment values.

classes.name: pcg_xsl_rr_128_64
classes.description: Mixing function for 128-bit to 64-bit output in PCG.

classes.name: pcg64_params
classes.description: Parameter class for 64-bit PCG engine with specific multiplier and increment.

classes.name: pcg_xsh_rr_64_32
classes.description: Mixing function for 64-bit to 32-bit output in PCG.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates the next random number by advancing the internal state and applying the mixing function.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Initializes the generator state with a seed value or seed sequence.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Advances the internal state by a specified number of steps.
